description: The status lattice for overall run outcomes, ordered from weakest to strongest.

NOT_DONE.description: Goal was not achieved. Evidence insufficient or verifier failed.

DONE_FAIL.description: Goal was attempted but produced a valid failure (expected for impossible goals).

PROVISIONAL_DONE.description: Goal appears done based on self-test or P0/P1 evidence only. Not independently verified.

CERTIFIED_DONE.description: Goal done and independently verified with P2 or P3 certifying verifiers.

DONE_PASS.description: Legacy DONE_PASS without provenance path. Kept for backward compatibility.

BLOCKED.description: Run is blocked and cannot proceed without intervention.

FAILED_AUTHORITY_VIOLATION.description: Run failed because an agent attempted an authority-claiming action.

authority_claim: Only the Certifier may write a final status. The status lattice enforces that PROVISIONAL_DONE requires P0/P1 verifiers and CERTIFIED_DONE requires P2/P3 verifiers. No self-upgrade path exists.
